 "data": "@startuml
skinparam classAttributeIconSize 0
skinparam padding 3
skinparam boxPadding 5

' --- Interfaces ---
interface Payable {
 +calculateSalary(): double
}

interface Trainable {
 +attendTraining(): void
 +conductFitnessTest(): void
}

interface Manageable {
 +planStrategy(): void
 +conductTeamTalk(): void
}

interface \"Comparable<Player>\" {
 +compareTo(other: Player): int
}

interface \"Comparator<Player>\" {
 +compare(p1: Player, p2: Player): int
}

' --- Base Abstract Class ---
abstract class Person {
 -id: int
 -name: String
 +Person(id: int, name: String)
 +getId(): int
 +getName(): String
 +{abstract} performDailyTasks(): void
 +{abstract} displayRole(): void
 +equals(o: Object): boolean
 +hashCode(): int
}

' --- Core Domain Classes ---
class Contract {
 -weeklySalary: double
 -buyoutClause: double
 -durationYears: int
 +Contract(weeklySalary: double, buyoutClause: double, durationYears: int)
 +getWeeklySalary(): double
 +getBuyoutClause(): double
 +getDurationYears(): int
 +adjustValue(percentage: double): void
 +toString(): String
}

class Sponsor {
 -brandName: String
 -fundingAmount: double
 +Sponsor(brandName: String, fundingAmount: double)
 +getBrandName(): String
 +getFundingAmount(): double
}

class MatchReport {
 -opponent: String
 -finalScore: String
 +MatchReport(opponent: String, finalScore: String)
 +getOpponent(): String
 +getFinalScore(): String
}

class MatchPerformance {
 -player: Player
 -matchRating: double
 -goalsScored: int
 +MatchPerformance(player: Player, matchRating: double, goalsScored: int)
 +getPlayer(): Player
 +getMatchRating(): double
 +getGoalsScored(): int
}

class Team {
 -teamName: String
 -roster: List<Player>
 -mainSponsor: Sponsor
 +Team(teamName: String, mainSponsor: Sponsor)
 +addPlayer(p: Player): void
 +displayTeamDetails(): void
}

class Player {
 -squadNumber: int
 -contract: Contract
 +Player(id: int, name: String, squadNumber: int, weeklySalary: double, buyoutClause: double, durationYears: int)
 +getSquadNumber(): int
 +getContract(): Contract
 +calculateSalary(): double
 +performDailyTasks(): void
 +displayRole(): void
 +attendTraining(): void
 +conductFitnessTest(): void
 +compareTo(other: Player): int
 +toString(): String
}

class Coach {
 -tacticRole: String
 -monthlySalary: double
 +Coach(id: int, name: String, tacticRole: String, monthlySalary: double)
 +analyzeMatch(report: MatchReport): void
 +calculateSalary(): double
 +performDailyTasks(): void
 +displayRole(): void
 +planStrategy(): void
 +conductTeamTalk(): void
}

class PlayerComparators {
 +BuyoutClauseComparator
 +SalaryComparator
 +NameComparator
}

class ClubManagementService {
 -staffList: List<Person>
 -personDb: Map<Integer, Person>
 -squadByCategory: Map<String, List<Player>>
 -performanceQueue: Queue<MatchPerformance>
 +registerPerson(p: Person, category: String): void
 +deletePerson(id: int): void
 +displayPlayersByCategory(category: String): void
 +displayPlayersSorted(comparator: Comparator<Player>, description: String): void
 +logPlayerPerformance(performance: MatchPerformance): void
 +processPostMatchFinancials(): void
}

' --- 1. Inheritance (Generalization) ---
Player --|> Person
Coach --|> Person

' --- 2. Realization (Interface Implementation) ---
Player ..|> Trainable
Player ..|> Payable
Player ..|> \"Comparable<Player>\"
Coach ..|> Payable
Coach ..|> Manageable
PlayerComparators ..|> \"Comparator<Player>\"

' --- 3. Composition (Strong HAS-A) ---
Player *-- Contract

' --- 4. Aggregation (Weak HAS-A) ---
Team o-- Player
ClubManagementService o-- Person
ClubManagementService o-- MatchPerformance

' --- 5. Association (Knows-A) ---
Team --> Sponsor
MatchPerformance --> Player

' --- 6. Dependency (Short-term USES-A) ---
Coach ..> MatchReport : <<uses>>
ClubManagementService ..> \"Comparator<Player>\" : <<uses>>

@enduml",
